settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Use the 'ab' monogram. Square, at least 64×64.

settings.content: Colours and fonts are set in assets/theme.css under BRAND TOKENS. Editing the variables there updates the whole store.

settings.label: Sell as a pre-order
settings.info: On: products tagged 'preorder' show the pre-order badge, notice, button and cart checkbox, and each order line records the shipping window. Off: they sell as in stock.

settings.label: Pre-order discount shown on the site
settings.info: Shows the price after the discount next to the regular price. This only changes what is displayed: the discount itself is the automatic discount in Shopify admin. Set to 0 when the offer ends.

settings.label: Dollar amount off shown on the site
settings.info: Shows the price after this many dollars off, next to the regular price. Display only: the discount itself is the automatic discount in Shopify admin. Takes priority over the percentage. Set to 0 when the offer ends.

settings.label: Dollar offer starts
settings.info: Optional. Date and time the dollar offer starts, e.g. 2026-11-27 00:00:00 -0500. Before it, the regular price shows. Match the automatic discount's start.

settings.label: Dollar offer ends
settings.info: Optional. Date and time the dollar offer ends, e.g. 2026-11-30 23:59:59 -0500 (Toronto winter time). After it, the regular price shows again on its own.
